source.author: ov
source.text: Haec et plura ferox; me luridus occupat horror spectantem vultus etiamnum caede madentes crudelesque manus et inanem luminis orbem membraque et humano concretam sanguine barbam.
source.text_original: Haec et plura ferox; me luridus occupat horror / spectantem vultus etiamnum caede madentes / crudelesque manus et inanem luminis orbem / membraque et humano concretam sanguine barbam.
source.text_english: Thus he raged, and more besides; a ghastly horror seized me as I gazed on his face, still wet with slaughter, his cruel hands, his empty eye-socket, and his limbs and beard clotted with human blood.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: quaenam aligeris secat anguibus auras caede madens?
reuse.text_original: quaenam aligeris secat anguibus auras / caede madens?
reuse.text_english: What one, dripping with slaughter, cleaves the air with winged serpents?
